$comment: Cases both editors must judge alike, in the format of html.json: the Datastar attributes as the client reads them, their order on an element, the aliased prefix, filters written as values and what a computed may do.

cases.name: a type compared with evt.detail.type that datastar-fetch is never dispatched with

issues.message: datastar-fetch is never dispatched with the type 'start': Datastar dispatches started, finished, error, retrying, retries-failed and the datastar events the response sends. Did you mean started?
datastar-fetch is never dispatched with the type 'finshed': Datastar dispatches started, finished, error, retrying, retries-failed and the datastar events the response sends. Did you mean finished?

cases.name: a media query is written with or without parentheses and quotes, as the reference allows

issues.message: data-match-media is a Datastar Pro attribute; it needs the Pro bundle.
data-match-media is a Datastar Pro attribute; it needs the Pro bundle.
data-match-media is a Datastar Pro attribute; it needs the Pro bundle.

cases.name: an indicator after the init whose request it is meant to show

issues.message: data-indicator comes after data-init, which starts its request as Datastar applies it, before the indicator exists, so the signal stays false. Put data-indicator first.

cases.name: an indicator in the value form after the init, on a line of its own

issues.message: data-indicator comes after data-init, which starts its request as Datastar applies it, before the indicator exists, so the signal stays false. Put data-indicator first.

cases.name: an indicator before the init, after a delayed init, or after an init that sends nothing
plain Datastar attributes under the aliased prefix, and another library's of the same names
cases.source: <button data-on:click="@post('/x')" data-signals__ifmissing="{a: 1}" data-show="$a" data-bind="text: name" data-text="title" data-star-text="$a"></button>

fixes: <button data-star-on:click="@post('/x')" data-signals__ifmissing="{a: 1}" data-show="$a" data-bind="text: name" data-text="title" data-star-text="$a"></button>
<button data-on:click="@post('/x')" data-star-signals__ifmissing="{a: 1}" data-show="$a" data-bind="text: name" data-text="title" data-star-text="$a"></button>
<button data-on:click="@post('/x')" data-signals__ifmissing="{a: 1}" data-star-show="$a" data-bind="text: name" data-text="title" data-star-text="$a"></button>

cases.name: a key written after a hyphen on an attribute that takes none

issues.message: data-text-foo is not a Datastar attribute. Did you mean data-text?
data-show-more is not a Datastar attribute. Did you mean data-show?
data-init-x is not a Datastar attribute. Did you mean data-init?

cases.name: a computed that changes signals or calls an action

issues.message: data-computed must not change signals, and this changes $b: Datastar runs it again each time a signal it reads changes. Use data-effect for a side effect.
data-computed must not call actions, and this calls @post: Datastar runs it again each time a signal it reads changes. Use data-effect for a side effect.
data-computed must not change signals, and this changes $e: Datastar runs it again each time a signal it reads changes. Use data-effect for a side effect.
data-computed must not change signals, and this changes $k: Datastar runs it again each time a signal it reads changes. Use data-effect for a side effect.
data-computed must not change signals, and this changes $m.n: Datastar runs it again each time a signal it reads changes. Use data-effect for a side effect.

cases.name: a signal filter written as an attribute's value, held to what filtered reads

issues.message: include takes a regular expression or a string, and 5 is a number, so Datastar throws a TypeError as it matches a signal.
A signal filter has only include and exclude, so Datastar ignores exclde. Did you mean exclude?
data-on-signal-patch-filter takes an object of include and exclude, and 'counter' is a string, so Datastar reads no filter from it.
data-json-signals takes an object of include and exclude, and null is none, so Datastar throws a TypeError as it reads it.

cases.name: statements on lines of their own in data-on, and the listener options on a custom event
Knockout's bindings under the aliased prefix, whose $data, $root and $parent are no signal names
a bare signal name in data-bind under the aliased prefix
an init whose request is not sent as it runs: later, on an event, or a string that only names it
a keyed computed whose value is a function it never calls
the functions of the object form run, and a function they return does not

issues.message: data-computed must not change signals, and this changes $k: Datastar runs it again each time a signal it reads changes. Use data-effect for a side effect.

cases.name: data-ignore: nothing inside is Datastar's, as the client skips it
data-ignore__self: the element alone is skipped, its children are read
data-ignore on a void element skips that element alone
data-ignore under an alias
data-ignore ends with its element, implied end tags counted
a DOM event written with capitals is the event the browser fires once lowercased

issues.message: The browser lowercases attribute names, so this listens for keydown, the DOM event. Write data-on:keydown.
The browser lowercases attribute names, so this listens for click, the DOM event. Write data-on:click.

cases.name: __case with several values, which the client applies in turn
an interval of no duration runs as often as the browser allows

issues.message: Datastar runs the interval every 0 ms with __duration.0ms, as often as the browser allows. Write a duration such as __duration.1s.
Datastar runs the interval every 0 ms without a duration, as often as the browser allows. Write a duration such as __duration.1s.
Datastar runs the interval every 0 ms with __duration.0s, as often as the browser allows. Write a duration such as __duration.1s.

cases.name: a timing modifier the client reads no duration from waits 0 ms

issues.message: __debounce without a duration waits 0 ms. Write a duration such as __debounce.500ms or __debounce.1s.
Datastar reads no duration from __debounce.abc and waits 0 ms. Write a duration such as __debounce.500ms or __debounce.1s.
Datastar reads no duration from __throttle.leading and waits 0 ms. Write a duration such as __throttle.500ms or __throttle.1s.

cases.name: a threshold written as a fraction is read up to its dot

issues.message: Datastar reads __threshold.0.5 as 0: a dot separates arguments, and the threshold is a percentage. Write __threshold.50.
Datastar reads __threshold.25.5 as 25: a dot separates arguments, and the threshold is a whole percentage.

cases.name: a modifier written twice is read from the last

issues.message: Datastar reads only the last __debounce, __debounce.1s, and ignores this one.

cases.name: a listener's target, where a modifier sets another

issues.message: Datastar ignores __document with __window.
Datastar ignores __window with __outside.

cases.name: another library's data-star-* under the default prefix is no aliased Datastar attribute
evt read outside data-on, where the client hands none

issues.message: evt is undefined in data-text: Datastar hands an expression the event only in data-on, so reading from it throws a TypeError.
evt is undefined in data-show: Datastar hands an expression the event only in data-on, so reading from it throws a TypeError.
evt is undefined in data-init: Datastar hands an expression the event only in data-on, so reading from it throws a TypeError.
evt is undefined in data-on-signal-patch: Datastar hands an expression the event only in data-on, so reading from it throws a TypeError.

cases.name: another library's attribute of a Datastar name is told how to keep Datastar off it
cases.source: Tweet

issues.message: data-bind takes a signal name, not an expression. If data-bind is another library's here, data-ignore on the element, or an aliased bundle, keeps Datastar off it.
Datastar expression: Unexpected keyword 'this'. If data-text is another library's here, data-ignore on the element, or an aliased bundle, keeps Datastar off it.

cases.name: under an alias, data-ignore alone keeps Datastar off another library's attribute

issues.message: data-star-bind takes a signal name, not an expression. If data-star-bind is another library's here, data-star-ignore on the element keeps Datastar off it.

cases.name: a signal patch filter without the listener that reads it

issues.message: data-on-signal-patch-filter does nothing without data-on-signal-patch on the same element, which reads it.

cases.name: two dollars before a signal

issues.message: Datastar rewrites $count and leaves the $ before it, so the browser reads $$ as a JavaScript variable and throws a ReferenceError.

cases.name: an SVG attribute with a capital, written in one case

issues.message: This sets view-box, but SVG reads viewBox, a name with a capital, which the object form keeps: data-attr="{viewBox: ...}".
This sets viewbox, but SVG reads viewBox, a name with a capital, which the object form keeps: data-attr="{viewBox: ...}".

cases.name: await before an action

issues.message: Datastar expression: await is only valid in an async function, and Datastar compiles an expression as a plain one. An action sends its request without it.

cases.name: a Pro modifier the reference does not list is not judged
data-ignore itself is still judged, though what it covers is not
the foreign note is for an attribute with no key, which another library's would be

issues.message: Datastar expression: Unexpected end of input

cases.name: a prefixed event the browser fires in mixed case keeps it, and one written in lower case is no event

issues.message: This listens for webkitanimationend, which no browser fires: the event is webkitAnimationEnd. Write data-on:webkit-animation-end__case.camel.

cases.name: a filter beside data-on-signal-patch with a key or a modifier is read
view-box on an element that is not SVG's is no SVG name
